purpose.statement: Disposition each remaining onboarding authoring-audit finding into one executable owner task or an explicit product ruling.
purpose.why: The larger onboarding goal is a trustworthy path from source material to a published Barkpark document, but BP-ONB-16 through 22 identify different breaks in that path: discarded slugs, weak target receipts, duplicate actions, missing retrieval verbs, renderer defaults, and an HTML-to-block capability that does not exist. Splitting each real gap or recording a deliberate no-build ruling is the right intervention because one implementation cannot honestly solve all six domains, while leaving them in an audit paragraph makes ownership and completion unverifiable. If omitted, the parent epic can look reconciled even though specific user-intent losses have no owner.
